name: AE Member Enrollment — Pace Gauge
description: Quick visual check on how far along Member Annual Enrollment is: actual completion rate vs. the expected pace for this point in the cycle. Prototype (2026-09-30), leadership requested a 'Thermometer/Barometer for expectations' for both Member and Employer reporting -- this is the Member half, stylistically paired with a separate Employer widget.

feeds.description: Same consolidated model as sac-member-enrollment-widget/sac-member-operational-widget -- all 8 dimensions in this exact order -- RowKind, EventDate, Wave, Enrollment_Status, Defaulted, Defaulted_Timing, ActivityDate, Membership_Type. This widget only reads the StatusByWave row-kind.
Same consolidated model -- all 22 measures in this exact order (see sac-member-enrollment-widget's main.js header for the full list). This widget only reads MemberCount.

refresh.description: Re-renders the gauge from the currently bound data
